notes.title: [Update] The Wake ver. 1.1 has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37698990/d227adba6d16a11a0c7a844ea909733fe7abb57d.png[/img]

The Wake 1.1 version has been released.
We tried to apply the improvement requirements you have been talking about as much as possible.
I hope that you can play a little more comfortably.

[list]
[*] Added notification that appears when a new item is added
[*] Correction of confusing alphabet (P, V) design
[*] Added a notification that appears when the alphabet is reversed
[/list]

Thank you.
